name: Discrete Set Cardinality Isomorphism
description: Replaces the continuous interval lengths and isometry functions with discrete sets of integers and their cardinalities. The sequential precedence `p1 + p2 > T` is enforced by requiring the maximum of the first set to be strictly less than the minimum of the second set, forcing the model to reason about the bounds of set extrema rather than just summing lengths. The core capacity `sum(p) > T` is enforced by requiring exactly empty intersections among sets within a fixed discrete interval.
